notes.title: 2024-06-27 Update - Version 1.2.0 and new DLC!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, we'd like to share update 1.2.0 for CRYMACHINA with the following bug fixes:


 Fixed the new Head and Waist Personality Enhancement Gears displaying incorrect icons under certain conditions.
 Fixed Archive entry for Server Farm Patience having an incorrect network listed.
 Fixed Frontier Fort: Extreme stage keeping the New label even after clearing it.

Please report issues you may have to the Steam troubleshooting forum.


Additionally, the following two new DLCs are now available.

CRYMACHINA - Standard Uniform Set
CRYMACHINA - Trinity Set (Three additional playable characters)

Customers who already own other DLCs can save by purchasing one of the following two bundles to complete the contents.

CRYMACHINA - Complete Costumes (June 2024 Update)
CRYMACHINA Ultimate Edition (June 2024 Update)


Thank you for playing!

notes.title: CRYMACHINA - PC Features & Launch Week Discount
notes.content:
About the Game

What does it mean to be human? The truth behind the fall of mankind awaits you in the bleak world of CRYMACHINA!

This sci-fi inspired action RPG unites fast-paced combat with dark, striking visuals and follows the story of three E.V.E. (the recreated psyches of deceased humans instilled in synthetic bodies) as they seek their full-fledged humanity.

Utilize the full potential of your newly-granted robotic form by outfitting it with a myriad of equipment, including melee, ranged, and shoulder-mounted weapons. Enhance and augment your weapons to add powerful effects to each strike, and rip apart enemies with fiery combos and special skills.

PC Features

Read on to learn about the features and enhancements that were implemented into this release of CRYMACHINA.

4K Resolution and High Frame Rate

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/187f47354c3cc30baf6eb6c5bb73e7713b31fd5e.png

Explore Eden in stunning UHD and arbitrarily high frame rates, depending on your hardware.

Keyboard and Mouse Control Support
The keyboard and mouse can be used to play CRYMACHINA as effectively as with a controller to complement any preferred gameplay set up, from playing at your desk to the flexibility offered by a PC paired with your TV, remote play, or handheld PCs! This release includes precise mouse camera control and the ability to interact with menus using the mouse and keyboard.

Additional Graphics Options

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/97c1a70b1bc27735132aa2c8a4a0990b567fa458.png

Advanced graphics settings can be used to optimize your experience for your particular hardware setup.

Arbitrary Aspect Ratio: Steam Deck & Ultrawide Support

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/e8b443b01c21ce02bed525e19280d652cebd833a.jpg

The game scales to various aspect ratios. This has been tested from 21:9 to 4:3, but should also work well on any display in between, including the venerable Steam Deck’s 16:10 display.

Dive into the world of CRYMACHINA by visiting the Steam page, and take advantage of our special launch discount on the Ultimate Edition from now until October 30!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/a67ecef527910d0f8195e2c742d8196fd02a9b12.png

Thanks for reading!
